comments.text: Reached copywriting. article.md is a complete draft (about 2,700 words of prose plus tables), derived from the same source as the site MDX draft (state: draft, not published). Limatus: one editing round, verify = accept; remaining findings are attributed vendor figures, a verbatim quotation, and deliberate repeats of system names. Open items, all marked [result pending] in article.md with no values: (1) arm C of the fine-tune-Laya study at 800, 2,000 and 5,140 labels, and the learning-curve chart to re-render; (2) the drift probe; (3) the calibration diagnosis for the full fine-tune; (4) selective prediction (auto-accept coverage at 95% accuracy) for all six systems; (5) exploratory head-only runs at lower learning rates; (6) exploratory arm C at 20, 40, 80 labels. Final editorial approval is Ryan's. Stopping here; not publishing.
